subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: A classic Beijing visit: Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Juyongguan Great Wall, the Temple of Heaven and more. You fly Philippine Airlines round trip from Manila and stay four nights in a 5-star Beijing hotel with daily breakfast. Shop visits are part of the package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 19–23 2027 to Apr 2–6 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The National Aquatics Center built for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, seen from the outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium, built for the 2008 Olympics, known for its steel-lattice design.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A famous pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the world's largest public squares, in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The vast former imperial palace of Ming and Qing emperors, now a world heritage site.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known Great Wall pass northwest of Beijing set in mountain scenery.
placeDesc.Summer Palace: A former imperial garden of lakes, hills and pavilions in western Beijing.
placeDesc.Temple of Heaven: A historic temple complex where Ming and Qing emperors held prayers for good harvests.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional pedestrian street near Tiananmen with old shops and eateries.
